description: Source code for a JSON writer package 'jwriter' in Go, defining a Writer struct with methods for JSON encoding, string escaping, base64 encoding, and various data type serialization.

classes.name: Writer
classes.description: A struct for writing JSON data with various encoding options and methods for appending different data types.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the size of the written data.

methods.description: Outputs data to an io.Writer, resetting the buffer.

methods.name: BuildBytes
methods.description: Returns the buffer data as a byte slice, optionally reusing a provided slice.

methods.name: ReadCloser
methods.description: Returns an io.ReadCloser to read the data, resetting the buffer.

methods.description: Appends a raw byte to the buffer.

methods.description: Encloses raw data in quotes and appends to the buffer.
